comment: Indexes for the collections of the seeded sales_memory database, in the seed's own vocabulary: documents are keyed by _id and owner-scoped collections carry owner_salesperson_id. The unique _id index on change_log is what backs the change log's insert-only append in the database (with insertOne, a racing writer fails instead of overwriting). The memories text index powers the keyword-search fallback when vector search is unavailable. Applied by scripts/apply-indexes.mjs; the Atlas Vector Search index lives separately in db/vector-index.json because search indexes are created differently.
